transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: My name is Marco.
transcript.zh: 我是马可。

transcript.en: I'm Amira.
transcript.zh: 我是阿米拉。

transcript.en: Amira and I are here today with an interesting lesson about a hotel situation.
transcript.zh: 今天阿米拉和我为大家带来一节关于酒店场景的有趣课程。

transcript.en: Amira, why don't you give us a little bit more information?
transcript.zh: 阿米拉，你来多介绍一点信息？

transcript.en: Well, the situation is taking place in a hotel and someone is checking in and is obtaining an upgrade.
transcript.zh: 嗯，这个场景发生在酒店里，有人正在办理入住，并且获得了升级。

transcript.en: An upgrade, okay, that's an interesting word.
transcript.zh: 升级，好的，这是个有趣的词。

transcript.en: Why don't we listen to the dialogue and then we'll come back and explain all this vocabulary.
transcript.zh: 我们先来听对话，然后回来讲解这些词汇。

transcript.en: Good afternoon.
transcript.zh: 下午好。

transcript.en: What can I do for you?
transcript.zh: 有什么可以帮您？

transcript.en: I'd like to check in please.
transcript.zh: 我想办理入住。

transcript.en: I have a reservation under the name Anthony Roberts.
transcript.zh: 我用安东尼·罗伯茨的名字预订了房间。

transcript.en: All right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Roberts.
transcript.zh: 罗伯茨。

transcript.en: Oh, Mr. Roberts, we've been expecting you.
transcript.zh: 哦，罗伯茨先生，我们一直在期待您的到来。

transcript.en: And here is your key card to the presidential suite.
transcript.zh: 这是您总统套房的房卡。

transcript.en: But there must be some mistake.
transcript.zh: 但这肯定搞错了。

transcript.en: My reservation was for a standard room.
transcript.zh: 我预订的是标准间。

transcript.en: Are you sure?
transcript.zh: 您确定吗？

transcript.en: Let me double check.
transcript.zh: 让我再确认一下。

transcript.en: Yeah, here, this is my confirmation number.
transcript.zh: 你看，这是我的确认号。

transcript.en: You're right, Mr. Roberts.
transcript.zh: 你说得对，罗伯茨先生。

transcript.en: There seems to be a mix up.
transcript.zh: There seems to be a mix up。

transcript.en: Unfortunately, we're overbooked at the moment.
transcript.zh: 不幸的是，我们现在已经超额预订了。

transcript.en: So?
transcript.zh: 那怎么办？

transcript.en: Not to worry.
transcript.zh: 别担心。

transcript.en: We're pleased to offer you a complimentary upgrade.
transcript.zh: 我们很乐意为您提供免费升级。

transcript.en: Presidential suite, baby!
transcript.zh: 总统套房，太爽了！

transcript.en: Okay, everyone, that is nice, huh?
transcript.zh: 好了，大家，这很棒对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, the guy is really excited that he's gonna get the presidential suite.
transcript.zh: 是啊，这家伙对能住总统套房感到非常兴奋。

transcript.en: Yes, there's some interesting phrases and vocabulary items here.
transcript.zh: 是的，这里有一些有趣的短语和词汇。

transcript.en: And I know, Marco, you want to talk about some of them.
transcript.zh: 我知道，马可，你想讲其中一些。

transcript.en: Right, the first one, and this is really useful for all of our listeners who travel a lot.
transcript.zh: 对，第一个，这对我们所有经常旅行的听众来说非常实用。

transcript.en: This phrase will come in handy and it is, I have a reservation under the name.
transcript.zh: 这个短语会派上用场，它就是「用……名字预订的」。

transcript.en: Under the name.
transcript.zh: Under the name。

transcript.en: Under the name.
transcript.zh: Under the name。

transcript.en: Under the name.
transcript.zh: Under the name。

transcript.en: So before we explain this phrase, let's listen to some examples on how it is used in other situations and then we'll come back and give you more information.
transcript.zh: 在解释这个短语之前，我们先来听几个例子，看看它在其他场景中如何使用，然后回来给你更多信息。

transcript.en: My secretary made a reservation under my name.
transcript.zh: 我的秘书用我的名字预订了。

transcript.en: I'm sorry, sir. I don't have a reservation under that name.
transcript.zh: 对不起，先生。我没有用那个名字的预订。

transcript.en: Do you have a reservation under the name Smith?
transcript.zh: 您有用史密斯这个名字的预订吗？

transcript.en: Alright some really good examples there on how we could use this phrase in other situations.
transcript.zh: 好的，几个很好的例子展示了这个短语在其他场景中的用法。

transcript.en: But just in case, let me explain it real fast.
transcript.zh: 不过以防万一，让我快速解释一下。

transcript.en: Under the name means that when you go to the restaurant or a hotel and you tell them your name, they know that you are the person that they have been expecting, they have been waiting.
transcript.zh: Under the name 的意思是，当你去餐厅或酒店，你告诉他们你的名字，他们就知道你是他们一直在等待的那个人。

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Well, I have chosen another useful phrase for you and it is mix up.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我为你选了另一个有用的短语，就是 mix up（搞混）。

transcript.en: Mix up.
transcript.zh: Mix up。

transcript.en: Mix up.
transcript.zh: Mix up。

transcript.en: Mix up.
transcript.zh: Mix up。

transcript.en: There seems to be a mix up.
transcript.zh: There seems to be a mix up。

transcript.en: Before we talk about this phrase, let's listen to some examples of how it is used.
transcript.zh: 在讨论这个短语之前，我们先来听几个用法的例子。

transcript.en: There was a mix up at the airport and my bags were sent to Antarctica.
transcript.zh: 机场搞混了，我的行李被送到了南极洲。

transcript.en: I'm sorry sir, there's been a terrible mix up.
transcript.zh: 对不起先生，发生了一个严重的混淆。

transcript.en: We've given you the wrong baby.
transcript.zh: 我们给错了您婴儿。

transcript.en: Okay that was useful and funny.
transcript.zh: 好的，既有用又搞笑。

transcript.en: Yeah, that's the baby situation.
transcript.zh: 是啊，那个婴儿的情况。

transcript.en: Oh my god.
transcript.zh: 哦天哪。

transcript.en: I can't imagine that happening.
transcript.zh: 我无法想象这种事发生。

transcript.en: Yeah, I know.
transcript.zh: 是啊，我知道。

transcript.en: Well guys, so a mix up is a confusion or a misunderstanding.
transcript.zh: 好了各位，所以 mix up 就是混淆或误解。

transcript.en: Exactly, well put.
transcript.zh: 没错，说得好。

transcript.en: Alright Marco, what do you have for us?
transcript.zh: 好的马可，你给我们准备了什么？

transcript.en: Okay, the next word that we should take a look at is overbooked.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们该看看的下一个词是 overbooked（超额预订）。

transcript.en: Overbooked.
transcript.zh: Overbooked。

transcript.en: Overbooked.
transcript.zh: Overbooked。

transcript.en: Overbooked.
transcript.zh: Overbooked。

transcript.en: What does that mean?
transcript.zh: 这是什么意思？

transcript.en: So if a hotel or a flight is overbooked, it means that they are full.
transcript.zh: 所以如果一个酒店或航班 overbooked，意思是它已经满了。

transcript.en: They are more than full.
transcript.zh: 甚至超出了满额。

transcript.en: Right, so they cannot accept any more people.
transcript.zh: 对，所以他们不能再接受更多的人了。

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: Okay, now why is this phrase useful?
transcript.zh: 好的，那这个词为什么有用？

transcript.en: Because it happens all the time.
transcript.zh: 因为这种事经常发生。

transcript.en: There's so many other situations where you can use this word or hear it from other native English speakers.
transcript.zh: 有很多其他场景你可以用这个词，或者从其他英语母语者那里听到它。

transcript.en: For example, a bus or a train can be overbooked.
transcript.zh: 比如，公交车或火车也可能超额预订。

transcript.en: Exactly, that's really common.
transcript.zh: 没错，那真的很常见。

transcript.en: Okay, let's take a look at the last phrase for today and that is complimentary upgrade.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们来看今天的最后一个短语，就是 complimentary upgrade（免费升级）。

transcript.en: Complimentary upgrade.
transcript.zh: Complimentary upgrade。

transcript.en: Complimentary upgrade.
transcript.zh: Complimentary upgrade。

transcript.en: Complimentary upgrade.
transcript.zh: Complimentary upgrade。

transcript.en: So this means that, for example, when the hotel is overbooked and all of their standard rooms are full, they will give you a better room, a more expensive room, but free.
transcript.zh: 所以这意味着，比如，当酒店超额预订且所有标准间都满了，他们会给你一个更好的房间，更贵的房间，但免费。

transcript.en: Yes, because it was not your fault.
transcript.zh: 是的，因为这不是你的错。

transcript.en: Right, this also happens sometimes, if you're lucky, on airplane flights.
transcript.zh: 对，如果你幸运的话，这种事有时也会在飞机航班上发生。

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So if you are in economy class and an airplane, but for some reason it's overbooked, they will move you to business class or first class for free.
transcript.zh: 所以如果你在经济舱，但出于某种原因航班超额预订了，他们会免费把你转到商务舱或头等舱。

transcript.en: I have a similar story, but I'm not going to tell you about it now.
transcript.zh: 我有一个类似的故事，但我现在不打算告诉你。

transcript.en: For now, let's go and listen to the dialogue one more time and when we come back, we'll talk some more.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们再去听一遍对话，回来后我们再聊一会儿。

transcript.en: So?

transcript.en: Not to worry, we're pleased to offer you a complimentary upgrade.

transcript.en: Woohoo!
transcript.zh: 哇哦！

transcript.en: Presidential suite, baby!
transcript.zh: 总统套房，太爽了！

transcript.en: I love listening to this dialogue.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢听这段对话。

transcript.en: It's just so nice to see that someone is enjoying his upgrade so much.
transcript.zh: 看到有人对自己的升级这么开心真是太好了。

transcript.en: Yeah, especially since he was expecting just a really normal room and now he's going to be treated like a king.
transcript.zh: 是啊，特别是他本来只期待一个很普通的房间，现在却要被当国王一样对待了。

transcript.en: So Marco, have you ever gotten a complimentary upgrade?
transcript.zh: 马可，你获得过免费升级吗？

transcript.en: Yes, yes, I did.
transcript.zh: 是的，是的，我获得过。

transcript.en: When I was traveling through India, I bought a normal seat in the train.
transcript.zh: 我在印度旅行的时候，买了一张火车的普通座。

transcript.en: But for some reason, it was overbooked.
transcript.zh: 但出于某种原因，它超额预订了。

transcript.en: So I talked to the station manager and I got a complimentary upgrade to first class.
transcript.zh: 所以我和站长谈了谈，获得了免费升级到头等座。

transcript.en: I had a similar experience as well.
transcript.zh: 我也有过类似的经历。

transcript.en: I was flying from Shanghai to Qatar and I actually had an economy seat, but for some reason they just upgraded me and I was so happy.
transcript.zh: 我从上海飞卡塔尔的时候，本来买的是经济舱，但出于某种原因他们直接给我升了舱，我高兴坏了。

transcript.en: Oh, really?
transcript.zh: 哦，真的吗？

transcript.en: Like it wasn't overbooked?
transcript.zh: 那并不是超额预订？

transcript.en: Well, I'm not sure because normally the night flight is not that full, but they upgraded me for some reason and I was so happy.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我不确定，因为通常夜班航班不会那么满，但他们出于某种原因给我升了舱，我好开心。

transcript.en: It was an upgrade to first class.
transcript.zh: 是升到了头等舱。

transcript.en: Wow, that's really cool.
transcript.zh: 哇，那真是太酷了。

transcript.en: I would prefer a first class upgrade on an airplane, yeah, any day.
transcript.zh: 我更想要飞机上的头等舱升级，嗯，什么时候都想要。

transcript.en: Well, you know what really amazed me was like the food you get there.
transcript.zh: 嗯，你知道真正让我惊讶的是什么吗？是你在那里吃到的食物。

transcript.en: You know, you have a five course meal.
transcript.zh: 你知道吗，有五道菜的大餐。

transcript.en: Oh, really?
transcript.zh: 哦，真的吗？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: And you get all the drinks you can get, right?
transcript.zh: 而且你能喝到的所有饮料，对吧？

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: Yeah, I would be really happy there.
transcript.zh: 是啊，在那里我会非常开心的。

transcript.en: All right, everyone, we're out of time today, but be sure to listen tomorrow because we'll be back again with another great podcast.
transcript.zh: 好了，大家，我们今天时间到了，但明天一定要继续收听，因为我们还会带来另一期精彩的播客。

transcript.en: And also, don't forget to go to our website at EnglishPod.com and leave us all your questions and comments in our community forum.
transcript.zh: 还有，别忘了访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com，在社区论坛留下你所有的问题和评论。

transcript.en: Yes, and we would also appreciate your suggestions.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们也非常感谢你的建议。

transcript.en: And I hope you enjoyed the lesson today and Marco and I will be back tomorrow with another great lesson for you.
transcript.zh: 希望你喜欢今天的课程，马可和我明天会带来另一堂精彩的课。

transcript.en: But for now, it's bye!
transcript.zh: 但现在，再见了！
